name: Aquaguard Sure Champ
summary: Aquaguard Sure Champ is a 6-stage RO+UV water purifier with Nanopore Long-Life Filter Technology, delivering safe and healthy drinking water by removing bacteria, viruses, heavy metals, pesticides, and microplastics.
intro: Aquaguard Sure Champ is a high-performance 6-stage RO+UV water purifier designed to deliver safe, healthy drinking water from all water sources. Powered by Nanopore Long-Life Filter Technology, Aquasaver RO, and UV e-Boiling, it removes harmful contaminants while saving up to 60% more water. With a 2-year filter life, 6L storage, and free installation with a genuine service plan, it offers reliable, hassle-free purification for every home.
features: Nanopore Long-Life Filter Technology for protection against pesticides, microplastics, heavy metals, bacteria, viruses, and cysts.
Aquasaver RO Technology saves up to 60% more water compared to older RO systems.
Superior 6-Stage Purification with RO and UV e-Boiling for safe and pure drinking water.
2-Year Filter Life (up to 12,000 litres under standard test conditions).
UV e-Boiling Technology delivers water as pure as water boiled for over 20 minutes.
Additional Mega Sediment Filter extends filter life by removing fine dust and mud particles.
Compatible with Municipal, Borewell & Tanker Water (up to 2,000 mg/L TDS).
6-Litre Storage Tank for uninterrupted access to purified water.
LED Indicators for tank full, filter life, service reminders, and error alerts.
Free Installation, 2 Free Cleaning Services & Unlimited Repair Visits during the first year.
1-Year Warranty backed by Aquaguard's extensive nationwide service network.
